subject: Aligning next steps — proposal for weekly swing slots (US / EU / APAC)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@paygrid.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning next steps — proposal for weekly swing slots (US / EU / APAC)

Hi Sana —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed way to schedule the next meeting (technical deep dive / integration planning):

Recap (very brief):
- Primary goal: integrate Redwood inference for real-time payment-risk scoring in PayGrid's checkout flow.
- Key constraints: sub-50ms tail latency for check endpoint, VPC requirements for PCI-related flows, and a phased rollout (sandbox -> stage -> prod).
- Stakeholders: you (product), Liam (eng), and later security/compliance.

Proposal (scheduling):
We want to make the deep-dive accessible without forcing the same team to join at odd hours every week. Instead of a single fixed time, we suggest a small rotating pattern ("weekly swing slots") that rotates the heavy technical meeting across US / EU / APAC-friendly windows so the same people occasionally get a convenient slot. Proposed pattern (each slot = 60 min):

- US-friendly week (A): Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (good for West/East coast engineers)
- EU-friendly week (B): Wed 16:00 BST / 17:00 CEST (works for central engineering in EU)
- APAC-friendly week (C): Thu 19:30 IST / 22:00 AET (captures India/Australia engineers without making NA wake up super early)

Ask: can you and Liam pick which of these windows you prefer to start with next week? If none work, please propose 2 x 60-min windows that align with your core engineering hours and we'll rotate accordingly. We can keep the cadence weekly or biweekly depending on bandwidth — happy to accommodate.

I attached my notes from today's call to make sure we're aligned. If the pattern above looks reasonable, I'll prep a recurring series and include an agenda template for the deep-dive (integration checklist, sample payloads, KV/cache expectations, SLO targets).

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: discovery-notes-20270614.docx (docx)]

From: Sana Patel <sana@paygrid.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 18:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Aligning next steps — proposal for weekly swing slots (US / EU / APAC)

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Liam and I reviewed the proposed windows; overall this looks sensible and we like the rotating approach. A couple of notes from our side:

- Our engineering core hours are roughly 09:30–17:30 BST (we're UK-based).
- Liam asked that any APAC-slot avoid earlier than 18:30 IST if possible (their India team prefers post-standup hours).
- Given our other commitments, biweekly is preferable to weekly for the deep technical session to give engineers time to action items.

Preferences to start:
1) Start with the EU-friendly week (Wed 16:00 BST) next week as Week A.
2) Switch to a biweekly rotation: EU (week 1), US (week 3), APAC (week 5), repeat.

If that works on your side, we can confirm people who should be invited: myself, Liam, and one of our platform engineers (TBD). We'll forward calendar invites once you send the series.

Thanks — Sana
Sana Patel
Head of Product, PayGrid
[sana@paygrid.com]

Hi Sana —

Thanks — biweekly rotation makes sense and reduces churn. To be explicit about the pattern Karthik proposed (so calendar creation is straightforward):

- Rotation pattern (every 2 weeks):
  - Cycle week 1: EU-friendly deep dive — Wed 16:00 BST / 17:00 CEST (60 min)
  - Cycle week 3: US-friendly deep dive — Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (60 min)
  - Cycle week 5: APAC-friendly deep dive — Thu 19:30 IST / 22:00 AET (60 min)

Operational notes:
- We'll create a single recurring series with an explicit "Week A/B/C" in the title (so invitees know which rotation applies).
- I'll include an agenda with an integration checklist + expected artifacts (sample request/response, auth flow, network peering notes).
- For the APAC slot we'll record and upload the recording for NA/EU teams who can't attend.

Link to provisional calendar poll (select preferred start date): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-paygrid-swingslots

If Sana confirms starting with the EU slot next Wednesday, we'll publish the series and include meeting notes and the initial agenda.

— Karthik
